## Paper v12 — The Λ-Ouroboros Substrate

**Four Machine-Verified Mechanisms for Governed AI Runtimes**

Author: Stephen P. Lutar Jr. · SZL Holdings · ORCID 0009-0001-0110-4173

## Contents

| File | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `papers/v12/ouroboros-thesis-v12.md` | Full paper (12 sections + 3 appendices) |
| `papers/v12/README.md` | Overview + reading order |

## Four mechanisms

| # | Mechanism | Package |
|---|---|---|
| I | Λ-invariant family (Λ₅ / Λ₇ / Λ₉) | @workspace/ouroboros-invariant |
| II | Tamper-evident receipt chain | @workspace/ouroboros-resonance + ouroboros-anchor |
| III | Bekenstein-bounded cascade | @workspace/ouroboros-integrations |
| IV | Dual-witness verdict | @workspace/ouroboros-adapters |

Theorem 1 (uniqueness of Λ under axioms A1–A4) is machine-verified in Lean 4 at szl-holdings/lutar-lean.
